scenario_title_en: RFQ to L/C to PSI to Claim Arbitration
scenario_title_zh: RFQ → L/C → PSI → 索赔全流程

rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, this is Sarah from Hamburg Trading. We sent you an RFQ for 10,000 men's polo shirts. Could you quote FOB Shanghai and CIF Hamburg?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 嗨 Mark，我是汉堡贸易的 Sarah。我们发了 10,000 件男式 polo 衫的询盘。请报 FOB 上海和 CIF 汉堡价。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回复 RFQ 报 FOB/CIF 价
rounds.common_mistakes: FOB 与 CIF 同时报时要把海运费和保险费拆分清楚。
rounds.tips_zh: FOB + 海运费 + 保险费 × 1.1 = CIF；分项报价更显专业。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Sarah. FOB Shanghai is US$5.20 per piece. CIF Hamburg with sea freight + insurance is US$5.85 per piece. Valid for 7 days.

rounds.ai_message: Good. About payment — do you accept L/C at sight for first orders?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。付款——首次订单接受即期信用证吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 首次合作建议 L/C；成熟客户可改 TT。
rounds.tips_zh: 首次合作 L/C 对双方都安全；TT 30/70 适合成熟客户。
rounds.user_response_example: L/C at sight is fine for the first order. We will open the L/C within 7 days after PI confirmation.

rounds.ai_message: OK. I will issue the PI today with specs, FOB price, payment and lead time. Please confirm by signing and returning the PI within 3 days.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。我今天发 PI，含规格、FOB 价、付款和交期。请在 3 天内签字回签 PI。
rounds.common_mistakes: PI 回签前要核对：单价、MOQ、交期、付款条款。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 是合同前文件，回签即代表承诺所有条款。
rounds.user_response_example: PI received. I will review with our MD and sign and return within 3 days.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Once we receive the L/C, production starts. Lead time 35 days after L/C opening. Sample yardage for approval will be sent by DHL.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。收到信用证后启动生产。开证后 35 天交期。确认样布 DHL 寄出。
key_phrases: L/C will be opened in 7 days
rounds.common_mistakes: L/C opening 7 天是合理；不要承诺 24 小时。
rounds.tips_zh: L/C 开立 5-7 天是行业标准；含银行审核时间。
rounds.user_response_example: L/C will be opened within 7 days. 35 days lead time after L/C opening is confirmed. DHL sample yardage is appreciated.

rounds.ai_message: About inspection — we will arrange a PSI (Pre-Shipment Inspection) before goods are released. The inspection will be based on AQL 2.5 for major and minor defects. OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 关于验货——出货前安排 PSI（出货前检验），按 AQL 2.5 主、次缺陷标准。可以吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: AQL 2.5 是行业标准；AQL 1.0 更严，AQL 4.0 更宽。
rounds.tips_zh: AQL 2.5 一般检验 II 级方案是服装最常用抽样标准。
rounds.user_response_example: AQL 2.5 is fine. PSI should be arranged 3 days before the ex-factory date. Third-party QC is accepted.

rounds.ai_message: After PSI passes, we will issue the B/L. Payment is at sight against shipping documents. Please send 3 originals + 3 copies of invoice, packing list, and B/L.
rounds.ai_message_zh: PSI 通过后我方会出提单。即期付款凭装运单据。请提供发票、装箱单、提单各 3 正 3 副。
rounds.common_mistakes: 3 正 3 副是行业标准单证套数；不是 1 正 1 副。
rounds.tips_zh: 3 正 3 副是国际通用单证套数；信用证下必须严格遵守。
rounds.user_response_example: 3 originals + 3 copies confirmed. B/L will be issued after PSI passes. Documents will be sent by DHL courier.

rounds.ai_message: Good. One issue — when our QC inspected the bulk, the defect rate came out at 3.2%, exceeding your AQL 2.5 limit. We are filing a claim on 3.2% of the shipment, total US$1,664. How would you like to handle this?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。一个问题——我方 QC 验大货时缺陷率 3.2%，超过你 AQL 2.5。我方对 3.2% 货值提出索赔，共 1,664 美元。你方想怎么处理？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回应 AQL 超标索赔
rounds.common_mistakes: AQL 超标要立即分类：主缺陷还是次缺陷；不同方案。
rounds.tips_zh: AQL 超标时区分主、次缺陷；主缺陷必须返工，次缺陷可让步。
rounds.user_response_example: We propose a 50/50 split — we accept US$832 in credit note and rework the major defects before shipment. Please share the QC report.

rounds.ai_message: OK. We accept the 50/50 split. The credit note US$832 will be deducted from the current invoice. The remaining shipment after rework will pass AQL 2.5. We will re-arrange PSI before final release.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意。我们接受 50/50 分摊。832 美元贷记通知将从本张发票扣减。返工后剩余货品可通过 AQL 2.5。出货前会重新安排 PSI。
rounds.common_mistakes: 贷记通知 credit note 要写明金额和发票号，避免挂账不清。
rounds.tips_zh: 贷记通知是双方留底凭证，要写明金额、发票号、生效日期。
rounds.user_response_example: 50/50 split accepted. Credit note US$832 received and deducted. PSI re-arranged. Looking forward to closing this cleanly.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Sarah from Hamburg Trading. We are sending a new RFQ for 30,000 pieces of men's woven shirts, CIF Hamburg, L/C at sight. Before I send it, can you handle our compliance docs — REACH, OEKO-TEX and BSCI?
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是汉堡贸易 Sarah。我们要发 30,000 件男式梭织衬衫的新 RFQ，CIF 汉堡，即期信用证。发询盘前你能处理合规文件吗——REACH、OEKO-TEX 和 BSCI？
rounds.common_mistakes: 三大合规是欧美客户入门门槛：REACH、OEKO-TEX、BSCI/SEDEX。
rounds.tips_zh: REACH + OEKO-TEX + BSCI 是欧美大客户的基本门槛，三证齐备是合作前提。
rounds.user_response_example: All three are available. REACH SVHC test report, OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class II certificate, and BSCI audit with A rating.

rounds.ai_message: Excellent. The L/C will be opened by Commerzbank Hamburg, confirmed by Bank of China Shanghai. Latest shipment date is October 30. Partial shipments and transshipment are not allowed.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 很好。信用证由汉堡商业银行开立，中国银行上海分行保兑。最晚装运日 10 月 30 日，不允许分批装运和转运。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认 L/C 关键条款
rounds.common_mistakes: partial shipment 和 transshipment 是 L/C 关键条款，要先看。
rounds.tips_zh: partial shipment 与 transshipment 是 L/C 关键条款；不允许会限制出货灵活性。
rounds.user_response_example: Latest shipment October 30 noted. Partial shipment and transshipment not allowed — we will load in one 40HQ. Please also allow a 7-day shipment window for buffer.

rounds.ai_message: 7-day shipment window can be added by amendment. About the L/C amount — will it be the exact CIF value, or with a 10% tolerance?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 7 天装运窗口可通过改证增加。L/C 金额——是精确 CIF 金额，还是加 10% 公差？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在精确金额与公差之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: L/C 金额公差太小会造成议付困难；太大又有风险。
rounds.tips_zh: L/C 金额 10% 公差是行业惯例；保护双方避免小幅金额差异拒付。
rounds.user_response_example: 10% tolerance is standard practice. We are fine with that. Please confirm in the L/C draft.

rounds.ai_message: Now about pre-shipment — we will engage SGS for PSI. They will inspect at AQL 2.5 general inspection level II. If any critical defect is found, the whole shipment is rejected. Are you ready for zero tolerance on critical defects?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 关于出货前——我方委托 SGS 做 PSI。按 AQL 2.5 一般检验 II 级方案。如发现任何严重缺陷，整批拒收。你方能接受严重缺陷零容忍吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: critical defect 零容忍是行业标准；要工厂内 100% 检验。
rounds.tips_zh: 严重缺陷（critical defect）零容忍；工厂内 100% 检验是 PSI 前的必要动作。
rounds.user_response_example: Zero tolerance on critical defects is standard. We will do 100% inline inspection plus final audit before SGS arrives. Accept this clause.

rounds.ai_message: Now about a potential issue — our buyer's QC mentioned that your last shipment had a 4% defect rate for broken stitching on the collar. Have you fixed this on the production line?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 现在说一个潜在问题——我方买家的 QC 提到你上批衣领断线缺陷率 4%。生产线上有改进吗？
rounds.common_mistakes: 衣领断线通常是机针磨损或操作问题；具体改善要说清楚。
rounds.tips_zh: 衣领断线常见原因：机针磨损、操作手法、线张力。要给出具体改善。
rounds.user_response_example: We have changed needles every 48 hours instead of weekly, retrained all collar operators, and increased SPI from 10 to 12 on the collar seam. CAPA report attached.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now the negotiation — the SGS PSI came back with defect rate 2.8%, just above AQL 2.5. This is below our buyer's internal threshold of 3% but above our contractual AQL. We are willing to accept the shipment with a 5% credit note on the FOB value. US$7,800 total. Is that acceptable?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。SGS PSI 缺陷率 2.8%，略超 AQL 2.5。低于我买家内部 3% 阈值但高于合同 AQL。我方愿接受出货但开 5% 贷记通知，FOB 货值共 7,800 美元。可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在 5% 贷记与返工之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: PSI 2.8% 略超 AQL 2.5，可让步但要明确条款。
rounds.tips_zh: PSI 2.8% vs AQL 2.5 略超 0.3%，可让步但要写明贷记金额与扣减方式。
rounds.user_response_example: 5% credit note on FOB value US$7,800 is acceptable to close this order cleanly. Please issue the credit note with reference to this L/C number.

rounds.ai_message: Credit note issued under L/C number HH-2026-088. Now the next issue — your shipment arrived 5 days late, missing our retail launch on October 15. The buyer is asking for an additional 2% late-delivery allowance, US$3,120. Can you accept?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 贷记通知已按信用证号 HH-2026-088 开具。现在另一个问题——你船晚了 5 天，错过 10 月 15 日零售首发。买家要求额外 2% 延迟让利，3,120 美元。能接受吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在让步与解释延期之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 延期索赔可分客观（不可抗力）和主观（厂内原因）；要诚实说明。
rounds.tips_zh: 延期索赔要诚实分类：客观（船期、天气）vs 主观（厂内排产错误）。
rounds.user_response_example: We accept the 2% late-delivery allowance US$3,120 — the delay was due to fabric late delivery from our upstream mill, which was beyond our control. We have already switched mills for the next order.

rounds.ai_message: Understood. Final accounting: 5% quality credit note US$7,800, 2% late-delivery allowance US$3,120. Total US$10,920 to be deducted from the L/C negotiation. We will release the B/L once both credit notes are received. Looking forward to a smoother next order.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。最终账目：5% 质量贷记 7,800 美元、2% 延期让利 3,120 美元，合计 10,920 美元从 L/C 议付中扣减。收到两份贷记后放提单。期待下次更顺利。
rounds.common_mistakes: 贷记通知要分别开立并标注 L/C 号；便于议付行扣减。
rounds.tips_zh: 多份贷记通知要分别开立，标注对应 L/C 号，便于议付行处理。
rounds.user_response_example: Both credit notes issued under L/C HH-2026-088. B/L released as agreed. We will work on smoother production planning for the next order.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, Sarah from Hamburg Trading. We have a serious issue — the L/C opened by Commerzbank has a discrepancy: the 'shipment date' on the B/L is October 28, but the L/C requires latest shipment by October 25. This is a 3-day late discrepancy. The negotiating bank has refused payment. We need to discuss immediately.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，我是汉堡贸易 Sarah。有严重问题——商业银行开的信用证有不符点：提单装运日 10 月 28 日，但 L/C 要求最晚 10 月 25 日装运。晚了 3 天。议付行已拒付。需立即沟通。
rounds.common_mistakes: L/C 不符点要在 5 个工作日内处理；超过则银行不再受理。
rounds.tips_zh: UCP 600 第 14 条：银行审单 5 个工作日内通知不符点。
rounds.user_response_example: I understand the urgency. Per UCP 600 Article 14, you have 5 banking days. Please first telegram the negotiating bank to extend the review, and we will request a waiver from Commerzbank today.

rounds.ai_message: We will request a waiver today. But — your shipment was actually late because your production was delayed by 3 days. This is not a bank error, it is a factory delay. We need to discuss both the L/C fix and the late-shipment liability.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我方今天会申请放弃不符点。但——你船晚了是因为你方生产延误 3 天，不是银行错误。我们需要同时讨论 L/C 修补和延迟船期的责任。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在责任分配与解决方案之间权衡
rounds.common_mistakes: 工厂延误与不可抗力要分开；诚实承担是建立信任的关键。
rounds.tips_zh: 工厂延误要诚实承担；不可抗力（台风、地震）才能豁免。
rounds.user_response_example: We accept the production delay liability. The 3-day delay was due to a fabric shortage at our upstream mill — documented. We will issue a 3% late-shipment allowance in addition to the L/C waiver request.

rounds.ai_message: OK. We will telegram Commerzbank for a waiver today, but we also need an indemnity letter from your side to protect us in case Commerzbank still refuses. The indemnity should cover US$156,000 (full L/C amount) plus interest.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好。我方今天电询商业银行放弃不符点，但也需要你方出具担保函，以防商业银行仍拒付。担保函覆盖 156,000 美元（L/C 全额）加利息。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在担保函与替代方案之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: indemnity letter（担保函）是议付保留下的标准做法；要双方律师审核。
rounds.tips_zh: indemnity letter 是议付保留（negotiation under reserve）的标准做法。
rounds.user_response_example: Indemnity letter is standard practice. We will issue a counter-signed indemnity covering US$156,000 plus interest within 48 hours. Our lawyer will review and sign.

rounds.ai_message: Good. Now the bigger issue — even with a waiver, the goods are already 3 days late and missed our retail launch. Our buyer is filing a separate commercial claim of US$45,000 for lost sales and brand damage, on top of the L/C amount. How do you propose to settle this?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。更大的问题——即便放弃不符点，货已晚 3 天错过零售首发。我方买家公司对销售额损失和品牌损害另案索赔 45,000 美元（独立于 L/C 金额）。你方想怎么和解？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在巨额索赔与谈判之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 巨额索赔要先看依据（合同条款、损失证明）；不要立即答应。
rounds.tips_zh: 巨额索赔要先看：合同责任上限、实际损失证明、品牌损害的因果关系。
rounds.user_response_example: US$45,000 commercial claim needs substantiation. Please share the lost-sales calculation and brand-damage evidence. Our contract caps consequential damages at the shipment value; we propose a settlement within that cap.

rounds.ai_message: The cap in our PO is the FOB value US$156,000. So your cap argument is valid. But within that cap, we propose US$30,000 settlement — 2% of FOB for late shipment, 5% for quality issues we may find on receipt, and the rest for our administrative and brand costs. Can you accept?
rounds.ai_message_zh: PO 中责任上限是 FOB 货值 156,000 美元。所以你方上限论点是有效的。但在此上限内，我方提议 30,000 美元和解——2% FOB 用于延期、5% 用于到货质量问题、其余用于行政与品牌成本。能接受吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在 30,000 和解与更低金额之间谈判
rounds.common_mistakes: 和解金额通常远低于初始索赔；先反报低一些。
rounds.tips_zh: 和解金额通常是初始索赔的 30-50%；反报低一些是行业惯例。
rounds.user_response_example: US$30,000 is high for a 3-day delay with documented upstream cause. We counter at US$18,000 — within our MD's authority. Above that needs corporate legal review which takes 30 days.

rounds.ai_message: US$18,000 is too low given the retail launch impact. Let me split the difference — US$24,000. This is my final offer. Below that, I need to escalate to our legal team for arbitration at the ICC International Court of Arbitration. Can you accept US$24,000 to avoid arbitration?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 18,000 美元对零售首发影响过低。我让一步——24,000 美元。这是最终报价。低于此我需上报我方法律团队，在 ICC 国际仲裁院仲裁。能接受 24,000 美元避免仲裁吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在和解与仲裁之间选择
rounds.common_mistakes: 仲裁成本高、耗时长；通常和解更划算。
rounds.tips_zh: ICC 仲裁单方成本 30K-100K 美元，周期 12-18 个月；通常和解更划算。
rounds.user_response_example: ICC arbitration is too costly for both sides. We accept US$24,000 to avoid arbitration, but our MD requires a written settlement agreement with no admission of liability. Please draft.

rounds.ai_message: Settlement agreement will be drafted today — no admission of liability, mutual release, confidential. The US$24,000 will be paid by credit note against the next PO. Now back to the L/C — we need a decision on the indemnity letter today.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 和解协议今天起草——不承认责任、互不追究、保密。24,000 美元通过下张 PO 贷记通知支付。现在回到 L/C——今天需要担保函的决定。
rounds.common_mistakes: 担保函要双方律师审核；不要让业务员口头承诺。
rounds.tips_zh: 担保函是法律文件，要双方律师审核签字，不要让业务员口头承诺。
rounds.user_response_example: Indemnity letter is being reviewed by our lawyer. Sign-off expected within 48 hours. We will courier the original to your bank tomorrow.

rounds.ai_message: Courier by tomorrow is acceptable. Final summary: L/C waiver request telegrammed today, indemnity letter by tomorrow, settlement agreement US$24,000 by credit note on next PO, no admission of liability. We will release the B/L once all three are in place. This was a painful order, but we want to continue the partnership on better terms.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明天快递可接受。最后总结：今天电询放弃不符点、明天出担保函、24,000 美元和解下张 PO 贷记支付、不承认责任。三件齐备后放提单。这单很痛苦，但我们希望以更好条件继续合作。
rounds.common_mistakes: L/C、担保、和解三件事要并行处理；任何一件不到位都不能放单。
rounds.tips_zh: LLC 不符点 + 担保函 + 和解协议三件并行；任何一件不到位都不能放提单。
rounds.user_response_example: All three will be in place by end of week. B/L will be released as agreed. We agree on better planning and earlier fabric buffer for the next order — to avoid this scenario again.
